messages:
Maya (Product): Dropping a quick design review thread for the approval flow microcopy + undo UX in eval runs. re: Figma https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/approvals Rae (Design): Two microcopy options: 'Approve selected (n)' vs 'Confirm approve'. I lean toward the former since it's explicit about selection. Also suggest a tiny helper: 'You can undo for 5 minutes.' Dev (Eng): Backend needs to support idempotent calls and an undo endpoint. We should chunk requests by 40 to avoid timeouts and surface per-item states in the UI (spinner, success, error). Omar (DevEx): UX: show a toast summarizing results with an 'Undo approvals' CTA that reverts only the successfully approved items. Toast must be keyboard-focusable. Also we should add a keyboard shortcut (Shift+A) to approve selection. Nina (Accessibility): A11y: toast must use role="status" and aria-live="polite". Ensure focus returns to the selection toolbar after closing the toast. For color, the green success label needs 4.5:1 contrast on both light and dark themes. Rae (Design): For mobile, bulk toolbar should be sticky at top of screen, not floating over content. On tiny widths collapse label to icon + count. Maya (Product): Prioritization: ship copy change + toast + aria fixes in sprint 1; chunking + per-row retry UI in sprint 2. ci-bot: New screenshot uploaded: approvals/compact-v2 by Rae. Dev (Eng): I'll open the backend PR and include an event payload with a hashed filter snapshot for audit. Also writing e2e that simulates partial failures and undo. Omar (DevEx): I'll add keyboard shortcut entry and draft microcopy for the undo window. Nina (Accessibility): I'll review the PRs for live-region snippets and color updates. Quick snippet suggestion:
Approved 8 tests.
Maya (Product): Great, thanks. I'll update the ticket with owners and mark the rollout as feature-flagged for a canary release.
